title: A goal research story's check reads its narrowed questions' coverage, not only that a work commit exists
goal: The check of a goal research story reads each question its narrowed goal names (rag.py pack coverage, or a gap entry for it), so done refuses research that left a question unanswered: at SP-4phd36pa backlog.py researched ST-bivdc2fa proved only a work commit while the fresh-context review that read the seven clauses found four S3 wording gaps (BG-az4r47gd, BG-lmp4mxmo, BG-drzst6zj, BG-o2spkwnz)

run:
import sys,types,io,contextlib;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_land
GOOD="How do I set the Windows Update deferral period for feature updates with Intune?"
NONE="What colour is the obsidian frobnicator valve of the Zorblax 9000 spectrometer?"
def researched(goal):
    it={"ST-bivdc2fa":{"kind":"story","goal_research":True,"sprint":"SP-a","goal":goal,"notes":"","touches":["kb/public/**"]}}
    bl=types.SimpleNamespace(items=it,root=".",label=lambda i:i,descendants=lambda i:[])
    buf=io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        rc=bl_land.cmd_researched(bl,types.SimpleNamespace(id="ST-bivdc2fa"))
    return rc,buf.getvalue()
ok=researched(GOOD);bad=researched(GOOD+"; "+NONE)
print(ok,bad);sys.exit(0 if ok[0]==0 and bad[0]==1 and "colour" in bad[1] else 1)

gates.question: Which coverage of a narrowed question lets researched pass?
options: good passes; weak or none refuses unless a gap entry names the question
only none refuses, unless a gap entry names the question
gates.recommendation: good passes; weak or none refuses unless a gap entry names the question
gates.answer: good passes; weak or none refuses unless a gap entry names the question

gates.question: In which kb roots does researched read each narrowed question's coverage, and what when the project has no kb_root?
options: the roots the story's touches name (kb/public/** is root public), all roots when none; skipped with a said line when kb_root is empty
only the root backlog.json's kb_root names
gates.recommendation: the roots the story's touches name (kb/public/** is root public), all roots when none; skipped with a said line when kb_root is empty
gates.answer: the roots the story's touches name (kb/public/** is root public), all roots when none; skipped with a said line when kb_root is empty

gates.question: How does researched find the questions in a narrowed goal?
options: each sentence of a goal clause that ends in ?, a lead-in of up to 8 words ending in a colon dropped; a goal with none reads no coverage
every clause of the goal is a question
gates.recommendation: each sentence of a goal clause that ends in ?, a lead-in of up to 8 words ending in a colon dropped; a goal with none reads no coverage
gates.answer: each sentence of a goal clause that ends in ?, a lead-in of up to 8 words ending in a colon dropped; a goal with none reads no coverage

gates.question: When a story's touches name several kb roots, which root's coverage answers a question?
options: the best root: good in any named root answers it
every named root must be good
gates.recommendation: the best root: good in any named root answers it

gates.question: Does a good verdict that carries a check: line (a possible false good) answer a question?
options: yes: the verdict as printed decides, the check: line does not refuse
no: good with a check: line counts as weak, as the knowledge state does
gates.recommendation: yes: the verdict as printed decides, the check: line does not refuse

gates.question: Which gap entry names a question for researched?
options: an open _gaps.md entry (tagged UNK, no Resolved line) whose title holds the question's key words, as kbfacts._gap_items reads it for a kb lacks route
any entry of _gaps.md that holds the question's words anywhere in its text
gates.recommendation: an open _gaps.md entry (tagged UNK, no Resolved line) whose title holds the question's key words, as kbfacts._gap_items reads it for a kb lacks route

gates.question: What does researched do when --root names another clone than the one the tools run from?
options: reads no coverage, says so and keeps the work-commit rule, as the knowledge state does
gates.recommendation: reads no coverage, says so and keeps the work-commit rule, as the knowledge state does

notes:
Filed as a retrospective draft at the SP-4phd36pa close. Recurred at SP-ajcomz6d (BG-ab3tndhy, BG-i44ewtyl: AlmaLinux 8 and 10 half-answered with no gap), SP-qjn563cf (BG-y3oykyfl, BG-l22a5sfd, BG-vdhzlmv3) and SP-up5wchen (BG-oyzgvtrg, BG-4e7ja4zv, BG-7ofeobia): researched passed on the work commit alone and only the fresh-context review found partial or wrong clauses. The questions are the narrowed goal's clauses (split as goal_clauses does); a project with no kb_root runs no pack and keeps today's work-commit rule. Gates answered at planning: question-coverage, question-roots.
Premise: researched on a story with a real work commit (ST-bivdc2fa) and a narrowed goal that adds a question the kb has no word for (pack coverage none) exits 0 today, as it does for an answered question (run 2026-10-12, main a5a7459f2): premise reproduces.
Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 19 of 19, "Close credits each goal clause to its carrier, and a research story's check reads its questions' coverage"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
